issues.evidence: The loudness curve is flat at -17 to -18 dBFS from about 90 s to 115 s. Accept all (10 of 10, ~104 s) and the laptop close (~112 s) get no measurable swell, lift or resolve. The script promises 'music swell' and 'music resolves'.
issues.suggested_action: Pull the bed down to about -24 dBFS from 86–100, swell to a +6 dB downbeat exactly on the 'All changes reviewed' cut, then let it resolve to a held chord under the laptop close at 112.

issues.evidence: cuts_on_sound_pct is 41.9. 18 cuts have no sound event, including 73.2, 76.2 and 86.2 in the proof, and the 102.2 and 106.2 payoff cuts.
issues.suggested_action: Conform the proof and payoff cuts to the score's bar lines (or move music accents onto them). At minimum, put hits on 76.2 (Word diff), 86.2 (match-cut ring) and 102.2.

issues.evidence: RMS is -43.5 dBFS for 7 s with no onsets from 2.7 to 10.85. The 'low drone' of block 1 dies after the hook, so David's text and the empty floor have no musical tension.
issues.suggested_action: Carry a low sustained drone (about -28 dBFS, 55–80 Hz pad plus a pulse at 70 bpm) from 0 to 31 and let it thicken into the grind.

issues.evidence: The grind holds about -19.7 RMS throughout with no climbing curve. The clock goes 12:31→2:31 but the music doesn't tighten.
issues.suggested_action: Add an ostinato that gains a layer at each clock stamp (33, 37, 47, 51) and cut it dead at 57.2 on the phone buzz.

issues.evidence: The loudest event is at 69.5 (-11.5); the 'Introducing' VO starts at 67.4. The riser and impact are not tied to the Diffs card cut.
issues.suggested_action: Land the impact on the frame where the Diffs wordmark appears and start score B on that downbeat. Riser from 64 to the hit.

issues.evidence: The timeline only promises the 'chime leitmotif' at the end card. Nothing ties the 92 s accept chime to the 120 s button or to the reveal.
issues.suggested_action: Make one 3-note accept chime (e.g. E5–B5–E6). Use it at the reveal (68), on Accept all (~103) and as the button at 125.
